name: Rejection Reason 2
definition: General information about the reason of the rejection.

RejectingPartyReason.name: Rejecting Party Reason
RejectingPartyReason.definition: Reason of the rejection provided by the rejecting party.

RejectionDateTime.name: Rejection Date Time
RejectionDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the rejection was generated.

ErrorLocation.name: Error Location
ErrorLocation.definition: Description of the precise location of the potential error in a message.

ReasonDescription.name: Reason Description
ReasonDescription.definition: Detailed description of the rejection reason.

AdditionalData.name: Additional Data
AdditionalData.definition: Additional information related to the rejection and meant to allow for the precise identification of the rejection reason. This could include a copy of the rejected message in part or in full.
